access_method: Exact administrator-configured HTTPS public discussion pages; no link following
allowed_purpose: Permissioned public discussion research; approval must cover storage and AI analysis
rate_limit: At least 2 seconds per request; honor robots crawl-delay/request-rate; default 10 pages per run
retention_policy: Source policy expiry, deletion and tombstones apply
attribution: Original page URL; author and original date unknown by default
restrictions: Public HTTPS only, exact page allowlist, fresh permission review within 30 days, robots must be available and allow the page, DNS/IP pinning, TLS verification, no redirects, no credentials or queries, 1MB decoded response cap. Stop on access challenges and 401/403/429. G2/Capterra/Reddit/LinkedIn/Discord/Slack require separate authorized integrations and are excluded.
